name: new-aria
description: Standalone transport copy of the ARIA repository-shaped intelligence surface: kernel, executor, adapters, agent prompts, contracts, CI lanes. Moved as-is to its own repository and run in Docker.

scripts.aria:compile: PYTHONPATH=aria-kernel python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; [compile(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), str(p), 'exec') for p in Path('aria-kernel').rglob('*.py') if '__pycache__' not in p.parts]"
scripts.aria:test:poc: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=.:aria-kernel python3 -m unittest discover tools/aria-poc/invariants -p '*test*.py'
scripts.aria:test:shared: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=.:aria-kernel python3 -m unittest discover tools/shared/invariants -p '*test*.py'
scripts.aria:gates:test: npx ts-node --project tools/gates/tsconfig.json tools/gates/aria-authority-hash.spec.ts && npx ts-node --project tools/gates/tsconfig.json tools/gates/plan-coverage-witness.spec.ts
scripts.aria:specialist-review:dry-run: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=aria-kernel python3 -m aria_kernel specialist-review dry-run --agents-dir .claude/agents
scripts.aria:burnin:observe: PYTHONPATH=aria-kernel python3 -m aria_kernel autonomy burn-in observe
scripts.aria:ci:all: npm run aria:compile && npm run aria:test:unit && npm run aria:test:poc && npm run aria:test:shared && npm run aria:adapters:test && npm run aria:gates:test && npm run aria:pedagogy:lint && npm run aria:specialist-review:dry-run
